newsitem.title: UK: Barclays, Citibank raise UK base rate to 6.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Barclays, Citibank raise UK base rate to 6.75 pct.

text.p: Barclays and Citibank said on Thursday they were raising their UK base lending rates to 6.75 percent from 6.50 percent with immediate effect.
The moves followed a 1/4 point rise in official interest rates by the Bank of England.
Halifax Plc, Woolwich plc and Alliance and Leicester plc said they were reviewing their mortgage rates.
A Halifax spokeswoman said, "We'll be reviewing our rates but there will be no immediate announcement of any change."
An Alliance spokesman said: "We do not expect a decision today."
